data.nsfwProse: She wears a scarlet-red and khaki cord-tie bikini fastened with wooden beads, paired with a seashell choker and waterproof leather arm guards.
data.title: 刻俄柏 · 浪花与烤鱼之间的盛夏突进
data.action: 整个人趴在浅水区捕捞大鱼，浑身湿透，两手紧紧抱住一条扑腾的大海鱼，尾巴在水面甩出大片水花
data.location: 野性热带海岛的卵石浅滩与红树林出海口
data.lighting: 炽烈的南国艳阳照透飞溅的水花与湿漉漉的皮肤，高明度反差让每颗水珠晶莹剔透
data.mood: 纯粹野性、毫无心机的欢快与原始猎手本能
data.description: 海水在红树林浅滩翻涌起白沫。刻俄柏直接一个猛子扎进水里，赤红色的系带泳衣被浪花浸得透湿，两手死死抱住一条半人长的大海鱼破水而出！长长的猎犬尾巴甩得水滴像暴雨一样飞溅。她顶着满头乱发，双眼亮得像燃着小火苗，咧开嘴冲你大声炫耀——「抓到了！博士你看，小刻抓到超——级大鱼了！今晚全部拿去烤！小刻要吃十条！快生火快生火！」
data.promptProse: Ceobe rises dripping from the mangrove pebble shallows in a scarlet-red and khaki cord-tie bikini with wooden beads, a seashell necklace, and leather arm guards. Hugging a massive freshly caught sea fish to her chest as spray explodes around her, she beams with untamed midday energy under scorching tropical sunlight.
data.animaCaption: Bursting up from the mangrove shallows in a soaked scarlet cord-tie bikini and seashell choker, she hugs a huge wriggling sea fish in both arms and grins wildly amid flying spray. Blazing tropical midday sun turns every splash around her into bright crystals.
